explanation: The main character in the book of Joshua, leader of the people of Israel and Moses' successor.
The area that God promised to give to the people of Israel as their inheritance and homeland.
A gift or property passed from one generation to another, especially within the tribes of Israel.
One of the twelve tribes of Israel, descendants of Joseph's son Ephraim.
Another of the twelve tribes of Israel, descendants of Joseph's son Manasseh.
Geographic areas assigned to each of the tribes of Israel as their inheritance and place of settlement.
Lines that mark the boundary between different territories or regions.
Populated areas where people live and work together, often protected by defensive walls.
A historical region in the Middle East that includes parts of present-day Israel, Palestine, Lebanon, and Syria. It was inhabited by the Canaanites before the Israelites conquered it.
